rationale: The tight flag is coiling exactly as the entry thesis described — price pinned at 31.93-31.95 within 5 cents of the high-of-day, still above rising VWAP (31.82) and the 9-EMA, with consolidation volume drying up (bars shrinking to 3-8k before modest return) and MAE of only -0.02%, indicating no real supply pressure. Neither the invalidation ($31.70) nor VWAP has been threatened, so there is no mechanical trigger to close, and flipping short would require a breakdown that has not occurred. Confidence stays modest because the flag hasn't expanded after 22 minutes and the tape (SPY -0.79%, VIXY +2.72%) remains a headwind, but the working structure and small open risk (~$86 to the stop against $549 of remaining budget) favor staying in.
